title: Cross-phase evidence index and benchmark normalization
objective: Unify M0/M1 benchmark metadata and evidence lineage so future formalization phases can be added without weakening replay guarantees.

in_scope: M0/M1 evidence aggregation, benchmark metadata normalization, corruption gates, CI evidence
out_of_scope: external repository mutation beyond the authorized GitHub remote

deliverables.name: Cross-phase evidence index
deliverables.acceptance: Generate a versioned index linking M0/M1 reports to benchmark IDs, source hashes, toolchains and replay status.

deliverables.name: Benchmark metadata normalization
deliverables.acceptance: Validate a common metadata contract across M0 and M1 without duplicating theorem policy in executable scripts.

deliverables.name: Corruption and replay gates
deliverables.acceptance: Reject mismatched report hashes, benchmark IDs, schemas and unregistered paths in temporary fixtures.

deliverables.name: CI evidence binding
deliverables.acceptance: Record which environment profile and workflow entry point produced each replay result.

deliverables.name: Readiness gate
deliverables.acceptance: Produce a machine-checkable M2 readiness report before adding the next benchmark phase.
